economy.title: Economy
economy.intro: Amounts in obols, read from the ledger. A faucet creates money, a sink destroys it; a negative amount is a reverse net (a repayment to a faucet, for instance).
economy.stale: The figures shown come from the previous read: they may be out of date.

partial.previous_one: The previous window covers only part of its day: this world's price history starts inside it.
partial.previous_other: The previous window covers only part of the {{count}} days: this world's price history starts inside it.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.queueCaption_one: {{count}} reported message, oldest first, then most reported
moderation.queueCaption_other: {{count}} reported messages, oldest first, then most reported
moderation.stale: Reports have been waiting for more than {{limit}} h (the oldest: {{hours}} h).
moderation.purged: Message purged: the report remains, with no text or context.

act.liftSanction: Confirm lifting the exclusion of account {{account}}
act.proposeLift: Propose lifting the exclusion of account {{account}}

confirm.hide: The message from house {{house}} will be hidden from players; moderation will still read it.
confirm.silence: House {{house}} will be silenced: it will not be able to write for the chosen duration.
confirm.suspension: House {{house}} will be suspended for the chosen duration.
confirm.ban: The exclusion of house {{house}} will be proposed. It takes effect only once another account confirms it.
confirm.upheld: The reports on this message will be upheld, with no sanction: pronounce one first if it is due.
confirm.dismissed: The reports on this message will be dismissed.
confirm.confirmExclusion: The exclusion of account {{userId}} will be confirmed: it starts at once. An account other than its author and the excluded account must confirm it.
confirm.liftSanction: The exclusion of account {{userId}} will be lifted now: it plays again at once, without getting back its cancelled orders. An account other than the one that proposed the lift must confirm it.
confirm.withdrawExclusion: The proposed exclusion of account {{userId}} will be withdrawn: it never took effect and leaves the queue. Any moderation account may withdraw it, its author included, except the excluded account.
confirm.proposeLift: Lifting the exclusion of account {{userId}} will be proposed: the exclusion still runs. An account other than yours must confirm the lift, and the excluded account does not.
confirm.granted: The appeal will be granted: the sanction of account {{userId}} will be lifted now if it is not over.
confirm.rejected: The appeal will be rejected: the sanction of account {{userId}} runs until its end.

moderation.hoursHint: The durations the configuration in force offers for this sanction.
moderation.hoursInvalid: Pick one of the offered durations.
moderation.hoursUnavailable: No offered duration could be read: the configuration in force is unreadable, or the API does not return them yet. Refresh; without a duration, this sanction is not sent.
moderation.reasonHint: The sanctioned account will read it. No control characters.
moderation.reasonInvalid: The reason is required and at most 2,000 characters.

done.ban: Exclusion of house {{house}} proposed: another account must confirm it.
done.withdrawExclusion: Exclusion withdrawn: it leaves the queue.
done.proposeLift: Lift proposed: another person must confirm it, from "Exclusion lifts to confirm".

config.title: Parameters
config.retiredInUse: Goods retired by this version and still held: scheduling it will be refused while they are.
config.goodInUse: {{good}} — houses: {{houses}}; units in stock: {{quantity}}; open orders: {{orders}}; escrow: {{escrow}} obols
config.buybackWarning: Buy back {{units}} units of {{good}} at {{price}} oboles each, from {{houses}} houses across all worlds: {{oboles}} oboles created by the buyback faucet, {{orders}} open orders cancelled (escrow returned, reservations released). The stock bought back leaves the game.
config.boughtBack: {{good}} stock bought back: {{units}} units from {{houses}} houses, for {{oboles}} oboles.
config.retiredUnconfirmed: Recipes and NPC classes retired by this version and still in use. Once activated, sites running these recipes will be halted for lack of a recipe (their houses may switch for free); a retired class keeps its population, which it resumes if a version brings it back.
config.confirmRetired: I confirm: schedule version {{number}} despite these recipes and classes in use
config.alreadyRetired: Recipes and NPC classes already retired by the version in force and still in use: a version without them does not retire them, so there is nothing to confirm.
config.schedule: Schedule version {{number}} for the next daily close
config.rollback: Roll back to version {{number}} at the next daily close
config.replaceWarning: The edited text of version {{opened}} is not saved: opening version {{number}} will replace it.
config.noDiff: No difference from version {{number}}, in force.
config.published: Version {{number}} saved. It is not scheduled yet.
config.cancelWarning: Every activation scheduled for this daily close will be cancelled: the version in force stays in force.
config.cancelledDone_other: Scheduling of version {{number}} for {{date}} cancelled, {{count}} activations of the same close in all.
config.invalidJson: This text is not a valid JSON object.
config.readOnly: Your role can view parameters but not change them.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.CONFIG_REVIEW_REQUIRED: The author of a version does not schedule it: another account must review and schedule it.
errors.CONFIG_CLOCK_CHANGED: The world clock cannot change: keep the tick duration, close hour and timezone of the version in effect.
errors.CONFIG_TIMEZONE_UNKNOWN: Time zone unknown to the database: player accounts would lose their day and season. Use the current name of the zone (for example Asia/Kolkata rather than Asia/Calcutta, Europe/Kyiv rather than Europe/Kiev).
errors.CONFIG_ACTIVATION_TOO_LATE: Too late to schedule for this close: it is less than a minute away. Try again after the close.
errors.CONFIG_ACTIVATION_PAST: Too late to cancel: the close has passed or is less than a minute away. Schedule a rollback instead.
errors.INTERNAL: The action did not complete. Try again: it will not run twice.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Request rejected: content too large or malformed.
errors.CONFIG_GOOD_IN_USE: This version retires goods still held in stock or carried by open orders (details under the version). Keep them in the configuration while houses hold them, or buy back their stock under the version (super administrator).
errors.CONFIG_RETIRED_UNCONFIRMED: This version retires recipes or NPC classes still in use (details under the version): tick the confirmation under the version, then schedule again.
errors.BUYBACK_CHANGED: Holdings changed since they were shown (order, harvest or buyback already done): nothing was bought back. Read the totals under the version again, then confirm again.
errors.GOOD_NOT_FOUND: The configuration in force no longer knows this good: without a reference price, it cannot be bought back.

config.diffPending: Differences from the version in force: loading…
